Money sheets

14 sheets view or edit one money movement, so they can share the new transaction layout: date pill, trash and close in the header, a big centred amount with its currency, one grouped card of rows, a slim note, one brand-coloured button. The buttons above the phones open the main ones side by side.

About 30 other sheets set something up rather than record a movement (debt and plan setup, budget lines, goal and pocket editors, zakat, emergency fund, account setup, batch SMS review). The 14 below follow the same approach: one header, sentence-case rows grouped in one card, the key number big in the middle, one brand button, and rare actions in a ··· menu. Open them from “Setup sheets” above.

Shared pieces to build once

  • TransactionSheet layout: one shell for the 14 sheets above.
  • Payment-method picker: grouped by bank with mini cards. Replaces 5 kinds used in about 15 places (carousel sheet, account list, chip rows, AI-chat strip, native select).
  • ConfirmDialog: save, discard, keep editing, and delete. Replaces 9 local dialogs; 30 screens already use the app's confirm hook.
  • Amount with currency: code muted, second currency as a ≈ line. The formatter bakes the code into 58 call sites today.
  • HeroBand: contained by default, cells become the note. Touches 8 heroes, plus the bespoke Budget and Paydays heroes.
  • List card: the Card "list" variant and 7 full-bleed lists move to rounded cards on phones too.

Font: every place Geist must reach

  • App layout font imports, the globals.css theme and number classes, and the Tailwind font config.
  • 383 uses of the mono number class in 184 files: switch the class once, not each file.
  • 6 inline font styles: amount field, date picker, welcome screen, expense sheet, OTP row.
  • Membership CSS modules: about 15 mono rules.
  • Arabic stays on IBM Plex Sans Arabic. Emails keep a fallback stack; the signature font and wordmark stay.
  • 3 tests pin fonts and need updating.

Easy-to-miss spots

  • Green call-to-actions off the design system: payday received, the payday link sheet, held-SMS confirm, the toast action, pull-to-refresh, notification inbox. They move to the brand colour.
  • Empty states (19), skeleton loaders (12 plus 6 ad-hoc): match the rounded card shape.
  • Buddgy chat cards: font, fewer badges, shared picker.
  • Uppercase eyebrow labels: 83 outside admin. They are calmer in sentence case, starting with the settings section title.

Empty states, loading, uppercase labels

  • Today: 8 different empty-state looks across 21 uses of the component plus about 15 bare one-line messages. Proposed: one EmptyState with three sizes (page, section, inline) and four kinds (first run, all clear, no results, error), so every icon sits in the same tile and buttons always stack the same way. See “States”.
  • Loading: one grey block list today. Proposed: placeholders shaped like the real rows inside the same rounded card, and a band-shaped block for the hero.
  • Uppercase: 81 inline eyebrow labels plus 4 shared tokens with 5 tracking values. Proposed: sentence-case section titles everywhere; keep caps only on card faces and tiny badges.

Other sheets worth the same treatment

  • Zakat and emergency fund: 7–9 mono figures each. One headline number and a fold-out breakdown.
  • Cleared debts: a green uppercase eyebrow on every row. Plain muted date instead.
  • Goal detail: badge and two buttons repeat the goal card. One button and a link.
  • Payday detail: hand-copied band. Use HeroBand.
  • Picker duplicates: the AI-chat picker and the card carousel sheet become the one picker.
